mapper.select: SELECT id, period, status, voucher_id, asset_count, total_amount, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted FROM ast_depreciation WHERE period = #{period} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, name FROM sys_dept WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN
#{id}

SELECT id, name FROM base_supplier WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN
#{id}

SELECT a.dept_id AS deptId, SUM(a.original_value) AS originalSum, SUM(COALESCE(dd.dep_sum, 0)) AS depSum, SUM(a.original_value - COALESCE(dd.dep_sum, 0)) AS netSum FROM ast_asset a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT det.asset_id, SUM(det.month_amount) AS dep_sum FROM ast_depreciation_detail det INNER JOIN ast_depreciation p ON p.id = det.period_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE det.deleted = 0 AND p.period <= #{period} GROUP BY det.asset_id ) dd ON dd.asset_id = a.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status != 'DISPOSED' AND a.account_date <= #{periodEnd} GROUP BY a.dept_id ORDER BY originalSum DESC

SELECT a.category_id AS categoryId, SUM(a.original_value) AS originalSum, SUM(COALESCE(dd.dep_sum, 0)) AS depSum, SUM(a.original_value - COALESCE(dd.dep_sum, 0)) AS netSum FROM ast_asset a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT det.asset_id, SUM(det.month_amount) AS dep_sum FROM ast_depreciation_detail det INNER JOIN ast_depreciation p ON p.id = det.period_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE det.deleted = 0 AND p.period <= #{period} GROUP BY det.asset_id ) dd ON dd.asset_id = a.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status != 'DISPOSED' AND a.account_date <= #{periodEnd} GROUP BY a.category_id ORDER BY originalSum DESC
